title: The plan names apps/<svc>/models.py; the swarm put the models elsewhere: the pre-commit gate has the file created before QA
source: example 09 live run 11-15 (docs/handoff/ex09-1115-dag-target-file-diagnosis.md): QA attempt 0 passed 16/16 tests, the adherence judge's file-less finding 'Expected target file apps/ex09-1115/models.py is missing (models were placed in apps/ex09-1115/schemas/portal.py)' sent the passing build back (REGENERATE, FINDING_NOT_ON_A_DRAFT_FILE) twice and the run failed
mechanism: PLAN-TARGET-FILES: V-PLAN-TARGETS reports the DAG target missing from the assembled tree as PLAN.TARGET_FILE_MISSING, a file to create routed to the author of another target of the same DAG task; the developer's repair loop writes it in the same dispatch, so the judge never sees a missing DAG file (before the fix: QA attempt 1 fails on the judge finding and the build is regenerated)

blobs.portal:

    SUPER_ADMIN = 'SuperAdmin'
